claims.quote: Variants in STX1B/syntaxin-1B are linked to a spectrum of fever-associated epilepsy syndromes.
These carried either a de novo p.G226R variant, associated with severe developmental epilepsy, or an InDel variant (p.K45delinsRCMIE/p.L46M) linked to a transient familial seizure syndrome.
